decision.route_gate: mean mark-out of N u S' >= 0 (no rebate)

declared.freeze: screen and replicate need a committed model_specs/cb8_v1.json carrying w_analysis_rules_sha256 and w_data_rules_sha256 equal to the code's
interpretations: Clip: prints of one wallet hash on one YES side of one market chained while consecutive prints are <= 2 s apart; size summed, VWAP YES price, notional = sum(size x token price) (the dollars traded). A clip's time is its LAST print (the clip and its size are complete only then). Prints without a wallet hash never form clips (they still count as prints, units and mark inputs).

Trigger: clip c2 of wallet w with some same-side clip c1 of w satisfying every declared rule; one trigger per c2 (the latest qualifying c1 is recorded). Every qualifying c2 is a trigger (a run of clips yields several overlapping windows, merged).

Skip window [tau, e): tau = t(c2) + 60 s; e starts at tau + 600 s and each further same-side clip of w with t(c2) < t_k < e moves e to max(e, t_k + 600), capped at tau + 3,600 s. Overlapping same-side windows merge (half-open; touching windows stay separate); a merged window carries the union of its trigger wallets.

Availability (capped / failed / missing days and the window edges): a print at s is a usable UNIT only if [s - reach, s] lies in the fetched window with no unavailable day, reach = 1,800 + 600 + lag + 3,600 s (6,060 s at lag 60; 6,300 s at lag 300). Any trigger whose window could cover s is then fully observable (exact S / S' / N classification), and a trigger whose look-back is not observable can only cover unavailable units.

Units are restricted to the declared 72-h window [w0, w0 + 72 h) and YES price in [0.03, 0.97]; prints in (w0 + 72 h, w0 + 74.5 h) serve marks only. A print inside windows of both sides is excluded (counted).

Mark M(u): (ask-side VWAP + bid-side VWAP) / 2 of all prints in [u - 900, u + 900] (any price), ask side = YES-side +1, excluding the trigger wallets of the unit's merged window (N units: no exclusion); both sides need positive size and the interval must be observable, else the unit is mark-unavailable.

Maker mark-out per share = yes_side x (p - M(s + 7,200)) with p the print's YES price; forgone rebate = REBATE_SHARE[cat] x DOCS_CATEGORY_RATE[cat] x p(1 - p) for prints on or after 2026-03-30 (cat = the sample's fee_category; unknown category -> 0). W1 = mean(mark-out + rebate) over S units of non-sports markets.

Cluster ways: Gamma event (cb8_flow.event_key), UTC day of the print, and trigger wallet: wallets that share a merged window are united (union-find over the stage), so a merged window never splits across wallet clusters (conservative: fewer, larger clusters).

Route gate (binding at the point estimate): mean mark-out over N u S' (non-sports, mark available) >= 0, WITHOUT the rebate the kept fills would earn (conservative); the with-rebate version is reported.

GW (>= 2,000 S prints with a mark, >= 300 merged skip windows, >= 30 events, 30 days and 30 trigger-wallet clusters among the marked S units; non-sports) is applied at both stages on the stage's own units; a fail, unverified disjointness or a missing seal -> W1 not testable, p = 1, counted.

Time-shift placebo: per market and draw one offset U[6 h, 66 h]; every trigger window [tau, e) keeps its length and wallets and moves to w0 + ((tau - w0 + offset) mod 72 h), wrapping at w0 + 72 h; shifted windows are merged; S units as W1 (same availability); advance = the p condition (floor off); 200 draws, seed 8182; calibrated iff the advance rate <= 1.5%.

Pseudo-pairs: consecutive same-side clips of the market (all wallets, time order) by different wallets meeting the gap, size-ratio and notional rules (no run-start or opposite-side rule); windows extend on ANY same-side clip; marks exclude both wallets. Credited iff W1 - W1_pseudo <= -|W1| / 2; no pseudo unit -> unverified (never credited; does not block).

Robustness (i): the mark averaged over s + 3,600 and s + 10,800 (both required); keeps the sign and >= half of |W1|. (ii) top 5 events / days by absolute summed value dropped: p condition and floor. (iii) size-weighted sign. (iv) months with >= 500 S units: declared sign in >= 2/3 (no qualifying month -> unverified, blocks). (v) worst case: mark-unavailable S units enter with mark-out max(0, kept-fill mean) plus their rebate; sign and p condition. (vi) lag 300 s: sign and >= half of |W1|.
Stage 2 uses p < alpha2 / k_used wherever Stage 1 uses 0.01; k_used = 1 + the other CB8 tests that advanced or have no final Stage-1 file yet.
BY triage label: p <= q / (m H_m), m = battery2.cumulative_count() at run time. Batch-Holm label k1 = 3, alpha 0.01; tests without a final file enter as p = 1.
MDE: the design's assumptions (SE about 0.15c at about 500 events) scaled by sqrt(500 / G_event) of the census; MDE = (z_0.99 + z_0.80) x SE; never used to change a floor.

robustness.worst_case: mark-unavailable S units at max(0, kept-fill mean) + rebate
